scope: isolated PostgreSQL 55439 and web 5179; no operational data
checks: MCP exposes nine tools with proposal submission and status, without immediate creation
Submission persists a pending draft, changes no schedule/revision, and retries idempotently
Bearer direct creation/import/review/apply/discard bypasses are rejected
Invalid tree/selection roll back without a draft version or schedule change
User editing preserves original, selection recalculates parent period, stale draft versions conflict
